schema: CREATE TABLE T1 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, group_id INTEGER, value INTEGER);
correct_query: SELECT group_id FROM T1 GROUP BY group_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT value) > 0;

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: CTE with SELECT DISTINCT followed by COUNT(*) includes NULLs, unlike COUNT(DISTINCT)
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: WITH distinct_vals AS (SELECT DISTINCT group_id, value FROM T1) SELECT group_id FROM distinct_vals GROUP BY group_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;
